x: Both long and short stage fastest times went to Belgrave athletes Allen and Andy Graffin. As is now often the case, the women's team were not far short of the men's performance, placing 5th and leading at the end of the first stage.

As the wind rose and another squall swept the start area Andrew Graffin set out on his mission to break away from the field. With a string of indoor sub-4 minute miles under his belt this winter, no doubt he'd have like to have cracked 14 minutes.
In the 1500 Andy Graffin followed up his previous day's 800 with a debut in the 1500 which turned out to be a high class and fast tactical race.

Highlights of a series of top rate performances were Andy Graffin's gun to tape charge in the A 800. Adam Zawadski got caught up in traffic jams on the M6 and being a fairly local lad arrived only 15 minutes before the A 800 and ran a pb in his first 800 of the season.

1500 metres - Andy Graffin. Before the runners had cleared the back straight for the first time one could see that this was going to be a real "championship" race with everyone relying on a final kick.
